sentences.text:
Rup Jaba Naskar & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on
10 July, 2025
Item 10.07.

In The High Court At Calcutta
 No. 2025 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 10 Appellate Side
Ct 32 Crr 5406 of 2024

rup Jaba Naskar & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.

Mr. Subhrangasu Maiti,
 Ms. Diksha Ghosh ... for the petitioners.

1. 
This revisional application has been filed with a prayer for quashing of the proceeding in connection
with B.G.R. Case No. 2472 of 2023 arising out of Bishnupur Police Station Case No. 422 of 2023
dated 31.05.2023 under Sections 498A/ 323/ 313/ 406/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that though there was an allegation of forceful abortion but nothing credible to that effect was found at the time of investigation.
Accordingly, chargesheet has been submitted under Section 498A/ 406/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It has been further submitted that there is no independent witness to corroborate the allegation made in the complaint which is omnibus in nature.
4. Having heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner as well as having gone through the documents annexed herewith, the same stands admitted.

5. Petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor of this Court and also to serve notice upon the opposite party No.2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

6. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of September, 2025 under the heading "Contested Application".
(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
